description: This file contains utility functions for managing and validating app bindings and forms within the Mattermost Redux project, including cleaning, validation, and static select options handling.

methods.name: cleanBinding
methods.description: Recursively cleans and validates an app binding, removing invalid entries based on location and structure.

methods.name: cleanBindingRec
methods.description: Helper function for recursively cleaning app bindings, handling nested bindings, forms, and validation rules.

methods.name: validateBindings
methods.description: Validates and filters an array of app bindings, returning only valid bindings.

methods.name: cleanForm
methods.description: Cleans and validates an app form, removing fields with invalid data or labels.

methods.name: cleanStaticSelect
methods.description: Removes duplicate or invalid options from a static select field.
